primarySources.summary: Reports zero Web Audio samples for a MediaSource-backed media element while the same bytes supplied as a Blob yield samples; affects multiple Web Audio node types.
Reports zero Web Audio analyser values for HLS sources while the reporter observed audible playback; progressive MP4 provided nonzero analyser values.

inference: The reported MediaSource observation is consistent with the local independent SDK MSE/Blob controls, but does not establish that this WebKit build has the same root cause or that local MSE output is audible.
scope: The exact deployed MP4 streaming worker was run with a finite local synthetic fixture at target zero; all source and output packet signatures and WebCodecs-decoded PCM hashes matched in each browser.
limitations: Collected full worker output is a test-only observation, not an incremental memory measurement.
WebCodecs decoding is independent of MSE presentation and cannot prove audible MSE output.
The issue reports describe their own Safari environments, not a verified binary match to Playwright WebKit 27.2.
No production qualification or release claim.
